purpose: Preserve the accelerated orchestration logic across chat sessions while keeping scientific and safety gates unchanged.
startup_logic: Verify current public master and current operational/evidence state before acting.
Snapshot live runner, workflow, agent and bounded mobile capacity; never trust stale availability claims.
Route every meaningful task to the smallest suitable free resource and execute independent work in parallel.

Use S10 as a continuously routed bounded mechanical research/QA worker: schedule every 20 minutes, plus meaningful research/governance pushes; rotate deterministic provenance, frontier-governance, PIT/clock/lineage, capacity-dispatch and negative-evidence/dedup checks. Semantic utility/evidence-critic runs remain manual or explicitly receipt-gated. Never manufacture work solely to create activity; when no independent useful task exists, the device may be idle.
Default S10 routing is deterministic mechanical QA; event-driven semantic utility review remains explicit and non-default.
Do not duplicate already-running work and do not consume quotas merely to create activity.
completed_round_chaining: When a bounded research round completes safely, automatically start the logically next receipt-defined round when its prerequisites are satisfied; never rerun an identical active round and never let a downstream round alter a frozen upstream trial.
research_pipeline: Orthogonal information first; prioritize genuinely distinct information clocks and economic mechanisms.
Cheap falsification before expensive formal work.
Expose robustness dimensions before any future performance authorization.
When a candidate completes all formal gates, trigger the predeclared unchanged independent replication immediately.
Immutable reconciliation and formal governance remain prerequisites to interpretation or promotion.

lane_a_formal_readiness.purpose: Coverage/PIT/authorization readiness for fully pre-registered candidates; candidate-specific compiler and provenance closure.
lane_a_formal_readiness.performance_allowed: only when the active research registry contains an exact true performance_authorization_allowed for that independent frozen trial

lane_b_frontier_discovery.purpose: Orthogonal source/PIT feasibility, cheap falsification and new information-channel discovery.
lane_b_frontier_discovery.current_focus: Q171-Q178, Q126-Q132 and related public-domain frontier work

self_hosted_windows.windows_pulse_cadence: 10 minutes while each pulse remains bounded, non-formal, and concurrency-protected

mobile.recurring_schedule: every 20 minutes plus meaningful research/governance push events
mobile.semantic_ai: manual/explicit utility or acceptance only; no default routing
mobile.routing_rule: Treat S10 as a continuously routable bounded QA lane. Prefer changing, independent repository/research-state checks; skip duplicate active work.

lane_isolation.rule: Separate candidate/trial IDs, branches/workflows, immutable receipts and output paths; no shared mutable research state between lanes.
lane_isolation.cross_lane_transfer: Only as a new explicitly frozen hypothesis after review; never mutate an already-frozen lane because of the other lane's results.

parallelism_policy.performance_capacity_rule: Two physical slots never create performance authorization. Parallel performance execution is permitted only when each exact trial has its own current formal authorization; otherwise performance remains fail-closed.

phone_capacity_policy.decision: Do not add another physical phone merely for nominal capacity.
phone_capacity_policy.current_state: S10 plus prepared Samsung fleet slots are sufficient for the present architecture.
phone_capacity_policy.activation_rule: Activate at most one additional Samsung device as a controlled capacity test when measured independent throughput gain is expected.
phone_capacity_policy.promotion_rule: Keep an additional device in recurring routing only when its measured workload throughput and reliability justify the extra operational complexity.
phone_capacity_policy.scientific_role: bounded QA/review/support only; no evidence, selection, ranking, authorization, promotion or live execution.

literature_discovery.principle: Continuously discover unusual, economically coherent and genuinely orthogonal information advantages; verify before adoption and preserve dead ends.
literature_discovery.anti_duplicate_rule: Do not keep a separate candidate when the proposed mechanism empirically collapses to an existing lineage; merge Q217 back into Q131 if processing-friction decomposition is not distinct.

integration_rules.speculative_language: predeclared control/alternative explanation for Q217/Q131, not a new candidate
integration_rules.customer_related_disclosures: pre-call business press coverage may be an identification control for Q212, not a second signal family
integration_rules.crsp_history_revision: hard reproducibility QA, not a candidate

rolling_capacity_wave_control.rule: When useful free capacity exists and a non-duplicate bounded backlog exists, keep the lane occupied with the highest-priority ready task.
rolling_capacity_wave_control.phase_rule: Skip active duplicates; skip phase-successful work; allow at most one retry after failure/cancellation; downstream workflows retain their own fail-closed gates.
rolling_capacity_wave_control.permanent_extension: After the two-hour lease expires, the same rule remains permanent through the existing 10-minute A/B loops and 20-minute Runner-C opportunistic pulse.
rolling_capacity_wave_control.dispatch_authority: capacity-saturation-rolling-waves.yml = sole automatic dispatcher; priority-research-wave-dispatch.yml = manual-only
rolling_capacity_wave_control.anti_scheinbeschäftigung: Do not rerun successful source probes; route only defined receipt-dependent next gates. Idle is valid when no useful independent backlog exists.

chat_continuity.rule: Persist material state before reporting completion; chat transcript is never the sole state store; do not commit for every message absent material state change.
